title: Completed inverse-limit realization of a lisse integral system
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $\Omega$ an algebraic closure of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, $E\subset\Omega$ a finite extension, and $X$ a Noetherian separated scheme on which $\ell$ is invertible. For a normalized lisse integral system $M=(M_n)_n$ in [def-pod-lisse-l-adic-sheaves], define its completed realization $\operatorname{Real}_E(M)$ to be the ordinary inverse limit of its finite-level pro-etale images, placed in cohomological degree zero. Use the identity-morphism finite-level site and scalar conversion from [def-wf-middle-extension], and the canonical exact coefficient presentation transport [def-pur-completed-coefficient-presentation-transport] to the intrinsic completed coefficient category. This specifies a functor on integral systems and compatible maps. For any constructibility witness on this actual object, its rationalized common-stage object is obtained by the localization [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi] followed by the inclusion at the literal field $E$ in [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. More generally write $J_E(K)$ for the object obtained by this same localization and inclusion for any constructible integral object $K$. For the geometric point $s=\operatorname{Spec} k$ of a finite-field datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], define $\operatorname{PtH}_E^i$ on the ambient completed derived category as the integral fibre functor of [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point], followed by $i$th homology and the inverse canonical ULift coefficient identification, taking values in $\mathcal O_E$-modules. All coefficient actions are the recorded constant-to-completion actions.
